import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "JACC") || Pkg.add(name="JACC", version="1")
using CUDA
import JACC
JACC.@init_backend
using JSON3

f1(i, y, a) = (@inbounds y[i] = a[i] * 2.0; nothing)
fbig(i, a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7,a8,a9,a10,a11,a12,a13,a14,a15,a16,a17,a18,a19,a20,a21,a22,a23,a24,a25) =
    (@inbounds a1[i] = a2[i] + a25[i]; nothing)

res = Dict{String,Any}()

# H1: does range = 0 fail?
try
    y = JACC.zeros(Float64, 4); a = JACC.array(ones(4))
    JACC.@parallel_for range=0 f1(y, a)
    res["range0"] = "ok"
catch e
    res["range0"] = "FAIL: " * first(split(sprint(showerror, e), "\n"))
end

# control: same kernel, range = 4
try
    y = JACC.zeros(Float64, 4); a = JACC.array(ones(4))
    JACC.@parallel_for range=4 f1(y, a)
    res["range4"] = "ok sum=" * string(sum(JACC.to_host(y)))
catch e
    res["range4"] = "FAIL: " * first(split(sprint(showerror, e), "\n"))
end

# H2: does a 25-array-argument kernel fail regardless of range?
try
    arrs = [JACC.array(ones(4)) for _ in 1:25]
    JACC.@parallel_for range=4 fbig(arrs...)
    res["args25"] = "ok"
catch e
    res["args25"] = "FAIL: " * first(split(sprint(showerror, e), "\n"))
end

println(JSON3.write(res))
